  decision = {The listings outside \texttt{ES} are split 60\,\% train, 10\,\% validation, 10\,\% calibration and 20\,\% test, with the seed \texttt{20251108}, both pinned in \texttt{params.\allowbreak{}yaml}.

  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item 70/10/10/10: halves the test set, so Volvo and Suzuki would fall under the 500 test rows SC-04 needs.
\item A stratified-group split on \texttt{make}: better make balance, but about half of the existing rows change set when the \texttt{ES} listings join, which confounds FR-15's retrain comparison.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} SC-04 checks a segment only from 500 test rows, so the test share decides how many makes the quality gate covers.
The seed is the snapshot date, so it is recognisable and obviously not tuned.
Over 20 other splits the candidate's test MdAPE is 6.73\,\% on average, with a standard deviation of 0.27 pp, and SC-01 and SC-02 hold on all 20.
Cars older than 20 years exceed the SC-04 bound on all 20 as well, at 18.3\,\% on average, so that miss is no artefact of the draw.},
